\noindent\parbox{\linewidth}{\fontsize{8}{9.2}\selectfont $H$: Hansen joint statistic; $h$: minimum segment transitions; M4: registered fitted-null fourth-moment qualification. Cuts use transition-row units; dates mark the first target after each cut. Unarchived dates remain -- even when cuts are available. Source codes omit the common PDPOS prefix. NR: daily FX NONREGULAR\_NULL (Student fourth moment unavailable); OF: hourly FX GARCH\_OPTIMIZATION\_FAILED. BF: a restricted-boundary fit; OK does not certify the model. Unavailable raw $p$ and Holm values remain --; internal Holm placeholders are not tests. Segmentation is descriptive, and the two-break cap does not establish significant individual breaks.}
